notes: Native ETH/SURF pool: currency0 is native ETH (zero address) and currency1 is SurfToken. The initial sqrtPriceX96 is 2^96 (1 SURF per ETH at 18 decimals); tickSpacing 60 and this price are the deploy script defaults and the test fixtures. The pool LP fee is 0 for the no-fees brief and beforeInitialize refuses any other fee value (FeeMustBeZero), including the dynamic-fee flag. BuyOnlyVoteHook charges no hook fee, overrides no LP fee and returns zero deltas from every callback, so nothing is routed to surfsurf.eth and the hook stores no recipient. The sole constructor argument is the launch chain's PoolManager, resolved from $poolManager. The token constructor takes no arguments. Permissions: beforeInitialize, afterAddLiquidity, afterRemoveLiquidity, beforeSwap, afterSwap; address bits 0x25C0 (9664); all return-delta permissions disabled; every declared callback accepts only the PoolManager. beforeInitialize binds the hook to the first pool initialized through it (AlreadyInitialized afterwards), requires currency0 to be native ETH, records the token and genesis timestamp, and fixes quorum at 1% of the token's totalSupply. Days are 24-hour periods from genesis. Buys (zeroForOne, ETH in, SURF out) always pass. During hours 0 to 23 of a day, accounts that staked SURF in the hook (stake/unstake) may vote once with their whole stake; unstaking is blocked for the rest of a day in which the account voted. The last hour of the day allows sells only if yes votes strictly exceed no votes AND yes plus no reaches quorum. The aggregate sell cap for a day is floor(previous day's net bought SURF / 2), first come first served; day 0 has no cap and nothing carries over. beforeSwap rejects sells outside an open window and exact-input sells over the remaining cap; afterSwap charges the SURF actually paid on every sell (exact-output included) against the cap. The cap counts net sells: a buy during an open window first cancels SURF already counted as sold that day and only the remainder counts toward tomorrow's cap. Liquidity: adding is always allowed; afterAddLiquidity records each position's liquidity and SURF principal under the PoolManager's position key (owner, tickLower, tickUpper, salt). afterRemoveLiquidity compares the SURF returned with the removed share of the recorded deposit; a shortfall beyond a 10^6 wei rounding tolerance is SURF that buys converted into ETH inside the position and is charged as a sell (window and cap, SellsClosed / SellCapExceeded, event LiquiditySold). Fee collection with zero liquidityDelta is never charged. No owner, no setter, no upgrade path: nobody can change any rule. Scope: the rules bind swaps and liquidity changes through this hooked pool only; SURF transfers and other venues are unrestricted. Vote weight is staked SURF, so large holders decide votes and a day without 10,000,000 SURF of votes keeps sells closed.
